baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated perfect verbs أَعْطَىٰ and ٱتَّقَىٰ in 92:5, joined under one indefinite agent.
baseline_models.mechanism: One motion releases something outward by handover; the other places the self behind a protective moral barrier. The pairing makes generosity and caution complementary operations rather than reckless openness versus withholding.

activation_trace.role: Handing over and giving supplies the outward transfer and functions as the release phase.
Placing the self in protective caution supplies guarded self-positioning and functions as the regulating phase.

changed_reading.before: A person performs two adjacent commendable acts: gives and guards.
changed_reading.after: The person couples outward release with inward protection: an open hand governed by a guardrail.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَعْطَىٰ can activate service that attends another's need, while ٱتَّقَىٰ retains the image of a barrier against harm.
baseline_models.mechanism: Giving is not exhausted by transfer of an object: it can be responsive attendance that supplies what another needs. Beside it, guarding makes care bounded and protective, so provision can shelter another without dissolving the giver's own moral boundary.

activation_trace.role: Serving by attending and handing over what is needed supplies relational care and functions as the provision of protection.
A barrier that wards off harm supplies concrete shelter and functions as the boundary governing the service.

changed_reading.before: Giving is a punctual donation followed by personal caution.
changed_reading.after: Giving can be need-attending service that makes protection available while the giver also preserves a protective boundary.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus root ع ط و carries a branch of taking on or reaching into an affair, immediately coordinated with self-guarding from و ق ي.
baseline_models.mechanism: A latent action geometry pairs committed reach with restraint: the agent enters a demanding affair but installs protection against the same reach becoming trespass or overextension.

activation_trace.role: Taking on or reaching boldly into an affair supplies expansion and functions as committed initiative with a live risk of overreach.
Putting the self in protective caution supplies restraint and functions as the guardrail on initiative.

changed_reading.before: The focus names generosity plus caution.
changed_reading.after: It also permits an exploratory image of entering costly action boldly while guarding that action from overreach.

context_deltas.mechanism: The covering/revealing alternation and the later divergence of purposeful movement recast the two focus verbs as regulation of a boundary. Giving opens a passage outward; guarding controls what may cross or harm the self. The agent is selectively permeable, not simply open or closed.

activation_trace.role: Handover supplies an outward crossing and functions as deliberate opening.
A harm-blocking barrier supplies closure and functions as selective boundary control.
A covering that rises over and conceals supplies the closed pole and makes guarded enclosure spatially visible.
Disclosure and appearance supply the open pole and make release a movement into visibility.
Purposeful motion toward an object supplies directed agency and functions as the motion passing through the regulated boundary.
Dispersion supplies divergent outcomes and functions as the reason boundary choices matter.

structural_cues: 92:1-2 alternate covering and disclosure; 92:4 then declares the strivings divergent before 92:5 selects one response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies covering, disclosure, directed striving, divergence, handover, and protection; I infer a single selective-permeability mechanism linking them. A live alternative is that the opening oaths frame contrast without assigning boundary mechanics to 92:5.

changed_reading.before: Giving and guarding are two separate virtues.
changed_reading.after: Giving and guarding are coordinated boundary operations: release what should pass outward while shielding the self from harmful capture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next sequence makes the gift an enactment that verifies the good rather than a detachable token. Guarding stabilizes that enacted commitment, and repeated easing describes feedback in which a chosen act becomes an increasingly traversable path.

activation_trace.role: Concrete handover supplies the deed and functions as material verification.
Protective moral caution supplies maintained orientation and functions as stabilization of the deed.
Making a promise true in action supplies performative verification and functions as the bridge from belief to gift.
Doing a beautiful or good act supplies the valued object and functions as the quality made operational.
Opening into ease after difficulty supplies reduced resistance and functions as path feedback after enacted commitment.

structural_cues: 92:5-7 is an uninterrupted sequence: give and guard, verify the good, then be eased toward ease.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies deed, verification, goodness, and subsequent easing; I infer that enacted commitment helps form the path it enters. Alternatively, the sequence may list independent traits followed by reward without path feedback.

changed_reading.before: The gift expresses an already settled inner goodness.
changed_reading.after: The gift materially verifies the good, while guarded enactment begins to make that direction easier to inhabit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The mirrored counter-sequence exposes retention as failed protection: withholding allies with claimed self-sufficiency, opens toward hardship, and accumulated wealth cannot avail at the fall. Against that chain, giving relocates security from the held asset to the guarded orientation of the agent.

activation_trace.role: Handover supplies release of possession and functions as withdrawal of trust from the stockpile.
Warding harm with a barrier supplies real protection and functions as the alternative location of security.
Miserly withholding supplies the closed-hand counteraction and functions as attempted preservation by retention.
Sufficiency supplies the claim of needing no support and functions as the false security premise.
Difficulty and severity supply the counter-path's resistance and function as the consequence toward which retention is eased.
Accumulated wealth supplies the retained reserve and functions as the tested but ineffective shield.
Falling into destruction supplies terminal exposure and functions as the event wealth fails to prevent.

structural_cues: The two أَمَّا clauses mirror giving against withholding and repeat the easing formula, while 92:11 tests wealth precisely at the moment of falling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a formal contrast and the failure of wealth at the fall; I infer a relocation of security from possession to protected orientation. A live alternative is that giving and guarding are merit conditions while wealth's failure is a separate eschatological observation.

changed_reading.before: Giving reduces one's reserve, while guarding supplies a separate moral safeguard.
changed_reading.after: Giving releases the reserve that only impersonates safety; guarded orientation, not retained wealth, becomes the operative protection.

context_deltas.mechanism: Guidance supplies a route, while the pairing of latter and former supplies temporal span. The focus verbs can therefore be read as entry operations: transfer and guarding do not merely describe a settled type but initiate a trajectory whose beginning and outcome remain connected.

activation_trace.role: Handover supplies a decisive outward act and functions as entry into a trajectory.
Self-protective caution supplies continuing regulation and functions as what keeps the trajectory oriented.
Gentle indication toward a road supplies direction and functions as the route connecting act to outcome.
Latter-ness after what is first supplies the far endpoint and functions as temporal extension.
The beginning and precedence of a thing supplies the near endpoint and functions as the point of departure.

structural_cues: 92:12 assigns guidance, and 92:13 places the latter and the former together after the two mirrored paths.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies road-direction and both temporal endpoints; I infer that 92:5 marks entry into a temporally extended path. Alternatively, 92:12-13 may assert ownership of guidance and times without making the focus acts trajectory-forming.

changed_reading.before: Giving and guarding are punctual evidence of a stable character.
changed_reading.after: Giving and guarding are threshold acts that enter and maintain a guided course from its first movement toward its later outcome.

context_deltas.mechanism: Warning identifies the harm, meeting fire gives that harm contact geometry, and 92:17 turns protection outward: the one marked by the same guarding root is passively placed to the side. Active self-guarding in 92:5 and effected separation in 92:17 become two phases of one protection relation.

activation_trace.role: Putting the self in protective caution supplies the active phase and functions as inward preparation.
A warning that awakens caution supplies hazard recognition and functions as activation of the guard.
Kindled fire supplies the concrete harm and functions as the object from which distance is required.
Encountering the fire and its heat supplies harmful contact and functions as the inverse of successful protection.
Being made separate and distant supplies spatial removal and functions as the externally effected barrier.
Warding harm by protection recurs in the superlative designation and functions as identity continuity with the focus guard.

structural_cues: The same root occurs in ٱتَّقَىٰ at 92:5 and ٱلْأَتْقَى at 92:17, where passive يُجَنَّبُ changes self-positioning into being positioned away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies warning, harmful contact, root recurrence, and passive separation; I infer continuity between active guarding and received protection. A live alternative is that ٱلْأَتْقَى only identifies the person and that the passive result is not presented as caused by the earlier act.

changed_reading.before: ٱتَّقَىٰ names inward moral caution performed by the agent.
changed_reading.after: Self-guarding participates in a two-sided process that later appears spatially as the agent being placed away from harm.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later giving echo specifies wealth as the outflow and places reflexive purification or growth beside it. What leaves the giver is not only transferred; its release loops back as a change in the giver's own condition.

activation_trace.role: Handing over supplies the initial outflow and functions as the focus action later specified.
Giving and bestowal supplies a lexical echo and functions as the later specification of the focus transfer.
Possessed and accumulated wealth supplies the released material and functions as what must cease to hold the giver.
Growth and increase supply positive self-change and function as the return generated through outflow.
Purity and soundness supply removal of contamination and function as release from possessive capture.

structural_cues: 92:18 identifies the earlier type through a continuing gives-his-wealth and reflexive purifies-or-grows construction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies giving wealth beside reflexive growth and purity; I infer that outflow is an instrument or medium of self-transformation. Alternatively, يَتَزَكَّىٰ may state motive or a concomitant trait rather than causal effect.

changed_reading.before: Giving changes the recipient's holdings while leaving the giver conceptually unchanged.
changed_reading.after: The outflow of wealth also acts back on the giver, loosening possession and enabling purification or growth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The negated repayable favor closes the horizontal ledger, while the exception redirects seeking toward a higher face or direction and delayed satisfaction. The focus guard can now protect the gift itself from capture by repayment, prestige, or creditor identity.

activation_trace.role: Giving supplies the transferable benefit and functions as the act whose exchange status is contested.
A protective barrier supplies insulation and functions as guarding the gift from reciprocal capture.
Exhaustive scope under negation supplies ledger-wide exclusion and functions as removal of every human claimant.
A favor or good condition supplies the possible social debt and functions as the item denied as motive.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies reciprocity and functions as the exchange mechanism explicitly negated.
Seeking an object supplies positive aim and functions as the replacement for repayment motive.
Direction and orientation supply a vector beyond the ledger and function as the gift's governing aim.
Satisfaction opposed to displeasure supplies eventual settling and functions as a non-priced completion of the act.

structural_cues: 92:19 negates any repayable favor, 92:20 supplies an إِلَّا exception, and 92:21 postpones satisfaction with وَلَسَوْفَ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exhaustive negation of recompense, a redirected seeking, and later satisfaction; I infer that the focus guard also guards motive and social relation. Alternatively, the context may only deny one repayment motive without excluding every form of social reciprocity.

changed_reading.before: Giving transfers a benefit and may leave a debt, reputation claim, or reciprocal expectation behind.
changed_reading.after: The giver releases the benefit without installing a creditor identity and guards the act from capture by repayment, aiming it beyond exchange.

context_deltas.mechanism: The service branch of the focus gift meets later images of growth and nurturing completion. Giving can therefore be carried as sustained attendance that clears conditions for development, nested under rather than equated with the Lord's completing nurture.

activation_trace.role: Attending to a person's affairs and handing over what is needed supplies sustained service and functions as cultivation rather than one-off transfer.
A harm-blocking barrier supplies protected conditions and functions as the enclosure within which service can foster growth.
Growth and increase supply developmental change and function as the result toward which service tends.
Nurturing, repair, and completion supply formative care and function as the higher process under which the giver's service is placed.

structural_cues: The later identifying clause extends the profile from one completed focus act into continuing giving and self-purification before naming the Lord.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies need-attending service, growth, and divine nurturing; I infer participation in a cultivation process, not identity between human giving and lordly nurture. A live alternative is that the growth concerns only the giver and the nurturing branch only names the Lord, leaving no cross-agent mechanism.

changed_reading.before: أَعْطَىٰ is a discrete transfer completed at the moment of handover.
changed_reading.after: It can also open an ongoing service relation that protects conditions for growth while remaining subordinate to a higher nurturing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The mutual-outdoing branch is surprising and form-distant for أَعْطَىٰ, but it remains anchored in the focus root and is sharply answered by the later branch of outdoing in recompense under explicit negation. Downstream prose should present this only as an evoked-and-canceled transaction frame, not as the lexical translation of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The ع ط و branch of outdoing in mutual dealing, activated in أَعْطَىٰ and reversed by the negated recompense sequence.

activation_trace.role: Outdoing another in mutual dealing supplies a competitive gift-frame and functions as the latent possibility later canceled.
Prevailing in reciprocal recompense supplies matching competitive exchange and functions as the frame placed under negation.
Matching an act with repayment supplies ordinary reciprocity and functions as the ledger from which rivalry would draw its score.
Seeking an object supplies redirected desire and functions as the noncompetitive aim replacing victory in exchange.

changed_reading.before: Giving may operate as reciprocal display: outgive, obligate, and win standing.
changed_reading.after: The focus gift can be heard as exiting the contest itself, refusing both repayment and victory in reciprocal scorekeeping.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This embodied reading is surprising because it activates reaching-by-hand and guarded-animal-gait branches rather than the ordinary senses of the two focus forms. It remains anchored in both focus roots and gains a coherent motion contrast from later ease and falling. Downstream prose should label it an image-schema for ethical action, never a replacement translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The paired focus roots can jointly stage an extending hand and a foot that tests harmful ground.

activation_trace.role: Taking or reaching by hand supplies forward extension and functions as the body's initiative.
A guarded gait that spares a hurting hoof supplies cautious contact and functions as risk-sensitive footing.
Light compliant movement supplies low-friction advance and functions as the gait produced when reach and caution align.
Falling toward destruction supplies failed footing and functions as the embodied counter-outcome.

changed_reading.before: The verse states an abstract pair of generosity and moral caution.
changed_reading.after: As a contained body-image, it depicts extending forward while testing one's footing: restraint is what lets initiative move without becoming a fall.

strongest_changes: The withholding-to-fall counter-sequence relocates security: released wealth is no longer simple loss, while retained wealth is exposed as an ineffective shield.
The recurrence of و ق ي beside passive separation converts self-guarding into a two-stage relation of guarding and being kept away from harm.
The final giving sequence specifies wealth outflow as self-transforming and protects the gift from reciprocal debt by redirecting its aim.
summary.what_was_special: The focus remained polyphonic: open hand and protective barrier, service and cultivation, verification that makes a path, selective permeability, and two contained contest and body images coexist without final disambiguation.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether giving causes purification and easing or primarily manifests an orientation already present.
Whether 92:17's passive separation is a consequence of 92:5's self-guarding or a redescriptive identification.
How far the form-distant focus branches of overreaching, outdoing, and guarded gait may shape an image-schema without being mistaken for lexical senses in this occurrence.
